title: Antique Odyssey
description:
A progression-focused adventure modpack where ancient magic, powerful relics and mechanical engineering shape your journey.

Explore a world filled with dangerous bosses, forgotten ruins, powerful spells and intricate machinery.
body:
# **⚙️ Mechanical Engineering**

Powered by the amazing systems of Create and its addons.

- Complex automation

- Mechanical factories
 
- Kinetic machines
  
- Vehicles and flying machines via Immersive Aircraft
  
- Storage systems via Tom's Simple Storage Mod

_Turn simple materials into industrial-scale production lines._


## **🔮 Deep Magic System**

Harness powerful magic with:

- Ars Nouveau
  
- Iron's Spells 'n Spellbooks
  
- Features:
  
- customizable spell crafting
  
- magical artifacts
  
- spell combat builds
  
- magical automation
  
_Develop your own spellcasting playstyle._


### **🗿 Legendary Boss Battles**

The world hides powerful enemies that require preparation and skill.

Bosses from:
  
- L_Ender's Cataclysm
  
- Mowzie's Mobs
  
- Bosses of Mass Destruction
  
- Born in Chaos
  
_Each boss unlocks new stages of progression and powerful rewards._

And many many other things...
